guidance: Ironclad A0 floor6 MAP at 60/80 HP, 146 gold, Explosive Ampoule. Choose the available Elite row6/col4 (map option1) to gain a relic while enough HP remains; its path leads to Unknown row7, Rest Site row8, Treasure row9 and Shop row10. The Rest Site option0 heals or upgrades now but leads to a Monster row7 and another Rest Site row8; this plan accepts the elite risk for greater strength. Fight for survival first: inspect each actual hand, enemy intent, and HP before every action; exploit Replay1 Strike and Bash→Dismantle/Molten Fist against Vulnerable, use Impervious on a large attack, and Colossus when its halving effect applies. Spend Explosive Ampoule to secure lethal or prevent meaningful damage, especially if a multi-enemy elite appears. Do not exhaust it for harmless damage. Claim the relic and all rewards; select a card for durable damage, mitigation or draw, skip weak additions. Stop at floor7 MAP, terminal or explicit safety boundary. If HP falls to <=8 with actions available, pause rather than gamble.
